title: Un Petit Noir, S'il Vous Plaît
obj: (1) Steal any Gig and drive to the Café du Tertre, . (2) Enter, order a coffee (△ at the zinc) to "case" the joint. (3) Smash 6 tables and chairs (OBJ-012) until the patron pays. (4) Return the takings (1,000 F) to Maza.
reward: 5,000 F; Apache R +8; brass knuckles upgrade.

title: Les Guetteurs
obj: (1) Reach the Café des Abbesses . (2) Three Velvet-paid lookouts (purple waistcoats) wait at the door and on the corner; knock out all three with knuckles only. (3) Smash the counter's bottle shelf (3 hits). (4) Collect 1,500 F.

title: La Fée Verte
obj: (1) Extort the absinthe bar Le Rat Mort ✎ (). The owner's bodyguard is a giant fort des Halles. (2) Defeat him (he has 3× ped HP; use a cobblestone to stun). (3) The absinthe haze (3 layers) halves visibility; find the owner hiding behind the drapes. (4) Make him pay 2,000 F.
reward: 7,000 F; Apache R +8; unlocks the cobblestone throw tutorial.

title: Le Lapin Ne Paie Pas
obj: (1) Go to Au Lapin Agile (). The patron refuses and calls the Avant-Garde for protection. (2) Fight 5 bohemian painters (palette knives) in the garden. (3) Smash the garden tables (4). (4) Collect 2,500 F.
reward: 8,000 F; Apache R +8; Avant-Garde R −6 (first taste of rivalry).

title: La Galette Rassis
obj: (1) The Moulin de la Galette's owner pays the Velvet Empire. Go to the dance hall at its day-time quiet (12:00–17:00). (2) Smash the buvette counter (OBJ HP 200) and the barrels. (3) Velvet sends a carriage of 4 hired toughs; defeat them. (4) Take the cashbox from the store room safe (watchmaker lock-pick tutorial, 3 rings). (5) Escape downhill with a 1–2 head chase to Belleville.
reward: 12,000 F; Apache R +12; Velvet R −8; **Apache knuckle-duster-dagger** combo weapon.

title: Le Ventre Ouvert
obj: (1) Arrive at Les Halles between 00:00 and 03:00. (2) Follow a wholesaler's clerk on foot (stay within 6 blocks but out of his 4-block rear check) through the crate oceans. (3) Learn the delivery dock (auto-marked).

title: Les Clés du Frigo
obj: (1) Pickpocket the dock foreman (L2 hold behind him for 1.2 s) for the ice-locker keys. (2) If spotted, chase him through the carcass rails. (3) Deliver the keys to La Môme Fil-de-Fer at the Fontaine des Innocents ().

title: Glace et Sang
obj: (1) Enter the ice lockers with the keys. (2) Retrieve a ledger hidden in a frozen carcass. (3) The wholesaler's guards arrive; lock yourself in the ice locker to wait for the Apache diversion (20 s, health drains 2%/s). (4) Escape through the cellar stairs.

title: L'Abattoir des Traîtres
obj: (1) The ledger names an informant: Fil-de-Fer's lover. (2) Capture him alive (knock out with fists/baton, don't kill) in the fish pavilion (slippery floor). (3) Drive him in a Gig to the ice locker. (4) Lock him in.

title: Le Grand Détournement
obj: (1) At 02:00, intercept the massive horse-drawn **meat transport wagon** (V09, 3 horses, 4,800 kg) inside Pavillon 3's central aisle. (2) Kill or eject the driver and two guards (shotgun recommended). (3) Navigate the carcass maze at walking pace (the wagon knocks down carcasses — they become slippery floor obstacles). (4) A 2-head chase erupts: mounted gendarmes and gardiens. (5) Drive the wagon
reward: 20,000 F; Apache R +12; Velvet R −8; unlock: Gros-Louis's fence orders.

title: Leçon de Danse
obj: (1) Collect a sword-cane from the Velvet tailor (by stealing it: a pickpocket on an aristocrat outside the Café de la Paix, C3). (2) Learn to conceal (R2) and draw it near foot police without alarming them — pass 3 gardiens.

title: Le Carnet de Bal
obj: (1) Gaston's mistress, a laundress (blanchisseuse), carries his dance card schedule. Find her at the Montmartre wash-house (). (2) Steal the card without violence (pickpocket, or win it in a game of chance — a dice minigame). (3) Read the card: the dances Gaston will dance and when.

title: La Caisse du Moulin
obj: (1) Plant the sword-cane inside the dance hall before Sunday (guests are searched at the door). (2) Enter Saturday night through the windmill (climb the sail gallery stair from the garden). (3) Hide the cane in the bandstand's piano. (4) While inside, retune the piano's lowest A with the tuning hammer — the signal to the Apaches that the plant is done.

title: La Valse Apache
obj: (1) Enter the dance hall on Sunday at 16:00 (unarmed — searched). (2) Retrieve the cane from the piano during the band's interval. (3) "Cut in" to the dancing crowd (△ on a couple); move with the anticlockwise flow. (4) When the third waltz begins (a musical cue), close on Gaston and strike from behind (sword-cane silent kill). (5) Leave the dance floor before the crowd notices (8 s), then exit vi

title: Les Ruelles Noires
obj: (1) Gaston's men pursue. Escape across the Butte's black alleys and stair tiles to the Lapin Agile. (2) Descend through its cellar into the Montmartre quarries. (3) Survive an ambush in a gypsum chamber (12 men; collapse tiles — shoot the pit-props to bring the roof down on them). (4) Surface in Belleville.
reward: 35,000 F; Apache R +12; Maza gives you the Belleville safehouse; "street eyes" perk.

title: Les Copistes
obj: (1) Escort Pépin (a copyist with an easel) to the Louvre's Grande Galerie (C5, entered as a copyist with a permit — real copyists worked in the Louvre). (2) Protect him for 3 in-game hours while he "sketches" the storeroom guards' routes (a timer; random hassle from Academic Salon students).

title: Le Châssis
obj: (1) Steal three period canvas stretchers from a framer's workshop in the Rue Laffitte (C3) at night. (2) Use a Buckboard; the stretchers are oversized cargo (top speed −20%, flips at lower lateral force). (3) Deliver to the Bateau-Lavoir without damage (cargo HP).

title: Bleu de Prusse, Vert de Paris
obj: (1) Collect 4 jars of rare pigments from apothecaries across the map within 10 minutes (D4, C6, E3, C1) for the forgeries to pass inspection. (2) One apothecary is an Academic Salon informant: he sets guards on you.

title: L'Ombre Chinoise
obj: (1) Rehearse the swivel: the cabaret's shadow-theatre screen acts out the plan (cut-scene). (2) Play the cabaret piano gig (§6.7.4) to grade A to provide Henri's alibi. (3) Meet the corrupt museum warder at a Morris column (its poster displays the code).
reward: 15,000 F; AG R +6; a "Mouvement Perdu" page.

title: Le Grand Échange
obj: (1) Infiltrate the storage facility at night via the Seine-side service door (). (2) Avoid 8 warders with lanterns (light nodes moving!). (3) Swap three masterpieces (each 4 s at a marked easel; the forgeries are in your Phaeton outside). (4) The third swap trips an alarm wire. (5) Load the originals into the **Phaeton** and escape across the Left Bank, where Haussmann works have left **open trenc
reward: 40,000 F; AG R +12; unlock: Avant-Garde Phaeton in garages.

title: La Fabrique
obj: (1) Scout the Ivry chemical works (G7) from a smokestack-top (climb ladder). (2) **Sketch** the loading schedule (a camera is too slow and too conspicuous in 1880) (stand still 6 s at 3 vantage points).

title: Le Fourgon Bleu
obj: (1) Hijack the specialised **chemical delivery wagon** (V06 Buckboard variant: sealed iron tanks; spills toxic puddles if hit — green-blue hazard tiles that damage peds). (2) Escape the factory yard through rusted corrugated fencing (ram: HP 250). (3) Drive carefully: the cargo destabilises the wagon (flip threshold −20%).

title: Le Train de Marchandises
obj: (1) The bulk shipment moves by goods train on the outer line at 14:20. (2) Jump onto a covered van from the Pont National bridge (timing window). (3) Fight 6 **corporate mercenaries** atop the moving rail cars — gaps between cars must be jumped (✕). (4) Uncouple the last 3 cars at the right junction so they roll into a siding.

title: Le Faux Wagon
obj: (1) Unload the pigment crates from the siding into a Buckboard before the railway company's armed response arrives (90 s). (2) Throw the **track switch** to send their relief locomotive the wrong way. (3) Drive the crates to a canal barge at the Bassin de la Villette (F1).

title: Arsenic et Vieilles Toiles
obj: (1) The firm hires the Velvet Empire to retaliate: defend the canal barge as it moves through the **Canal Saint-Martin vault** (the canal's covered tunnel, Underworld transition) against mercenaries on the towpath and in punts. (2) Man the barge's swivel-mounted blunderbuss. (3) Open a floodgate to sweep the punts away.
reward: 45,000 F; AG R +12; Velvet R −6; unlock: blunderbuss spawns.

title: Refusé
obj: (1) Attend the Salon's opening as a visitor (evening dress needed: steal a set from a Barouche passenger). (2) Mark 4 gallery entrances and the roof stair.

title: Les Caisses Vertes
obj: (1) Collect 5 crates of **Absinthe Molotovs** from 5 distilleries' back-rooms in Montmartre (C1–C2). (2) Deliver them to the Salon's service yard disguised as a frame-maker's wagon. (3) Avoid jolts: each crash over 50% speed risks a crate igniting (fire on the wagon, extinguish by driving through a fountain basin or a horse trough!).

title: Le Jury
obj: (1) Blackmail 3 jury members into keeping the galleries' night guards to a minimum: **sketch** them in compromising company at an opium salon (Velvet territory, C3), at a brothel door, at a gambling club. (2) Deliver sketches by pneumatic capsule.

title: L'Huile et le Feu
obj: (1) Night before the fire: in the galleries, soak 6 marked points with turpentine. (2) Avoid 4 Academic guards (brown frock coats, lanterns). (3) Rescue Henri's rejected canvas from the reserve (it must not burn).

title: La Nuit des Flammes
obj: (1) Enter the Salon at closing time. (2) Throw Molotovs at the 6 soaked points (fires spread as 2×2 tiles, gallery by gallery: 1 tile per 3 s). (3) The guards and fire brigade (sapeurs-pompiers: brass helmets, hand-pump wagon) arrive. (4) Climb to the roof and escape **via the skylights** across the glass roof (SKY tiles crack under the player: keep moving!). (5) Jump to the trees of the Champs-Él
reward: 60,000 F; AG R +15; Academic faction destroyed (their guards no longer spawn); Henri's finale unlocked (Mission 64).

title: Le Bouquet
obj: (1) Deliver a bouquet to the Garnier's stage door during the interval (disguise: florist's boy, provided). (2) Note the dressing-room corridor: 8 doors, the diva's is No. 1, stage left. (3) Leave without arousing the stage manager.

title: Le Cocher Corrompu
obj: (1) The diva's own Brougham coachman is loyal to her impresario. Bribe (2,000 F) or replace him: ambush his carriage at the livery stable (B3). (2) Deliver the coachman's coat and hat to Fauvel.

title: L'Armure de Velours
obj: (1) Collect an armoured **Barouche** from a coachbuilder in the Faubourg Saint-Antoine (G4). (2) Test it: survive 60 s of Apache gunfire in Belleville (hood up = +60% protection). (3) Return it undamaged above 70% HP.

title: La Loge Numéro Un
obj: (1) During the third act of the evening performance, enter the stage door as the bribed coachman. (2) Drug the diva's champagne with laudanum (place an item: △ at the dressing table). (3) Wait in the fly gallery until she returns at the interval and collapses.

title: La Rançon de la Diva
obj: (1) Carry the unconscious diva (carry state: walk only, no weapon) from dressing room No. 1 through the backstage corridor. (2) Her impresario's **private security** (6 men, revolvers) block the stage door; set her down and fight up and down the **Grand Staircase** to the Pavillon de l'Empereur ramp where the Barouche waits. (3) Stuff her into the Barouche (hood up). (4) Escape a 3-head pursuit to

title: La Partition
obj: (1) Steal the conductor's full score from the composer's house in the Plaine Monceau (A3) at night. (2) Copy the cue sheet at a copyist's in the Passage des Panoramas (D3) (wait 2 in-game hours while defending the shop from the composer's hired detective). (3) Return the score before dawn.

title: Les Cintres
obj: (1) Infiltrate the Garnier fly floor as a stagehand (disguise). (2) Re-tie 4 cleats in the rope-and-pulley maze so that flown scenery (a cloud chariot, a palace backdrop, a chandelier prop and a trapdoor counterweight) will drop on cue. (3) Avoid the head flyman.

title: Le Premier Avertissement
obj: (1) Opening night: from the fly gallery, release the first cleat at **bar 64 of the overture** (the HUD shows a metronome and a bar counter: Adam-style timing — releasing within ±1 beat is "perfect"). (2) The cloud chariot crashes harmlessly onto an empty stage. (3) Deliver the Velvet note to the composer's box: "La prochaine fois, ce sera la soprano."

title: Le Contre-Poids
obj: (1) The composer has hired Apache bodyguards. Ambush his Brougham on the Boulevard Malesherbes (B3). (2) Kill the 4 Apaches; spare the composer. (3) Drive him to the Sacré-Cœur works; dangle him from a crane hook over the pit (cut-scene, an homage to the threat-from-a-height scene type) until he signs.

title: La Chute du Lustre
obj: (1) The composer has double-crossed Vaneau with the Prefecture. Final performance: clear the stalls by triggering a fire alarm (the bell), while the composer stays in his box. (2) From the fly gallery, release the final cleat to drop the **great chandelier** (a 64×64 sprite, 4×4 block impact) on to the empty stalls. (3) Escape the Prefecture's plain-clothes ambush through the cellars, past the cis
reward: 60,000 F; Velvet R +12; the composer pays 100,000 F protection over the following week (passive income).

title: Le Croupier
obj: (1) Work a night as a croupier (a simple roulette minigame: stop the wheel by timing). (2) Identify a card cheat (watch for a ped whose sprite blinks a 1-frame "tell"). (3) Throw him out through the back alley.

title: Le Mouchard
obj: (1) The cheat was a police plant. Tail him to the Prefecture's antenna on the Rue de Provence. (2) Steal the raid plan from his satchel (pickpocket in a crowded omnibus — board the moving Omnibus).

title: Les Barricades de Velours
obj: (1) Prepare the den: place 4 barricades (crate stacks) at the stair and corridor chokepoints; arm 6 Velvet guards (deliver Winchesters from Armurerie Lepage). (2) Rig an Orsini tripwire in the coal chute.

title: La Descente
obj: (1) Defend the den against 3 waves of the Prefecture's **tactical squad** (Brigade de Sûreté plain-clothes inspectors and uniformed gardiens with revolvers and sabre-bayonets). (2) Wave 3 brings a battering ram team: destroy the ram before the door breaks. (3) Survive for 4 minutes.
reward: 50,000 F; Velvet R +10; Crimson R +2 (any blow to police pleases them).

title: Le Flush Royal
obj: (1) Evacuate the cash chest through the Garnier cellars and the sewer (on foot, 2 bearers to escort). (2) Discover Saint-Florent sold the raid plan. (3) Pursue his Barouche across the Grand Boulevards at 4 heads (the Army is called in for the first time near the Opéra). (4) Kill him; recover the chest.
reward: 80,000 F; Velvet R +15; Barouche unlocked; Velvet finale unlocked (Mission 65).

title: Le Cri du Pavé
obj: (1) Distribute 50 pamphlets (throw stacks into 5 tenement courtyards, H2) before the police notice. (2) Escape a 1-head gardien pair.

title: Le Dépôt des Saisies
obj: (1) Locate the government seizure warehouse (Bercy, H5) by following a police dray. (2) Climb to the warehouse roof and count the guards (3 vantage points).

title: La Chaudière
obj: (1) The press is too heavy for horses: it must go on a **steam flatbed** (V16). Steal the firebox key from a road-engine driver at the Ivry depot. (2) Gather coal (5 sacks) and water from a horse trough (it works for boilers too).

title: Le Cellier Rouge
obj: (1) Prepare the delivery route: clear rubble from the Underworld ramp under the Montagne Sainte-Geneviève (dynamite, 2 sticks). (2) Fight the smugglers who use the gallery.

title: La Libération de la Presse
obj: (1) Break into the seizure warehouse (kill or bypass 8 guards). (2) Hotwire the steam flatbed; wait 6 s for pressure while defending. (3) Winch the press onto the flatbed (2 lever points). (4) **Smash through a police barricade** of carts and gardiens on the Quai de Bercy (the flatbed's battering factor). (5) Deliver the press to the Underworld ramp and down into the "Cave Rouge" printing cellar.
reward: 50,000 F; Crimson R +12; Steam Road Omnibus guaranteed spawn at Ivry.

title: Le Plan de la Banque
obj: (1) Steal architectural plans from the city archives (Hôtel de Ville, E4) at night. (2) A guard dog patrol (dog sprites 8×6, fast) must be avoided or fed (meat from Les Halles — inventory item).

title: Le Tramway Volé
obj: (1) Hijack a double-decker steam tram at the depot (A4). (2) Drive it through the night network to a quiet siding near the Palais-Royal without a collision exceeding 3 (each collision with a carriage wakes the city: +heat). (3) Hide it under tarpaulins.

title: L'Heure Bleue
obj: (1) Synchronise the gang: reset 4 public clocks around the bank (watchmaker tamper, §1.2.1) so that police patrol shifts change 15 minutes late. (2) Shoot out 6 gas lamps on the Rue de la Vrillière so that, after the arc candles fail at 00:30, the street is black.

title: La Salle des Coffres
obj: (1) At 00:30, enter via the sewer (a manhole under the Rue Croix-des-Petits-Champs). (2) Tunnel the last 2 blocks (dynamite charge into a cellar wall). (3) Inside the vault antechamber, pick a clockwork time-lock (5 rings — the hardest lock-pick). (4) Plant 3 dynamite sticks on the main vault doors; take cover; detonate. (5) Load 12 sacks of gold coins (each sack = 1 carry trip, 3 s) onto a hand-c

title: Le Train d'Or
obj: (1) Pack the gold onto the hidden **steam tram**. (2) Drive the tram along the Rue de Rivoli rail line eastward as the army deploys: **plough through rows of soldiers and a barricade of overturned carriages** (the tram is unstoppable; soldiers fire volleys at the crew — the player must keep firing from the platform between throttle inputs). (3) Switch onto the Bastille spur (track switch — a gang
reward: 150,000 F; Crimson R +15; Velvet R −10 (the Velvet Empire banked there); Chapter IV unlock.

title: Les Masques
obj: (1) Steal 3 invitations by pickpocketing guests at the Opéra's foyer. (2) Steal Venetian masks from a costumier in the Palais-Royal galleries.

title: Le Bal Masqué
obj: (1) Arrive in a Barouche at the cour d'honneur. (2) Enter the Salle des Fêtes in a mask (disguise: guards ignore unless you run or show a weapon). (3) Dance one quadrille (the crowd-flow mechanic returns) to slip past the hallway guards. (4) Locate the executive study.

title: Le Coffre Mural
obj: (1) In the study, find the right hidden wall safe behind one of three paintings (examine: the correct one hangs crooked by 1 px). (2) Crack it (clockwork lock, 4 rings) and take the dossier. (3) Plant a timed dynamite charge (the HUD watch shows 3:00). (4) Choice: ring the alarm bell to evacuate the ballroom (Louise's way) or not (the "Ravachol" ✎ path — darker ending branch, Crimson R +5, all oth

title: Le Jardin de la Présidence
obj: (1) Escape the palace through the kitchens and laundry chute (cooks with cleavers) or across the gardens (mounted Garde républicaine patrols). (2) The charge blows at 0:00 (cut-scene: the study's windows burst — sprites — and the lids above glow orange).

title: Le Grand Égout
obj: (1) Enter the sewers at the Avenue Gabriel manhole. (2) The Army and the égoutiers' police (a special scripted underground patrol for this mission only) give chase. (3) Ride a **wagon-vanne** down the Grand Collector, opening **floodgates** to sweep pursuers away. (4) Reach the Asnières outfall and a waiting Crimson barge.
reward: 150,000 F; Crimson R +15; Louise's finale unlocked (Mission 66).

title: L'Horloger
obj: Personal story mission: recover the protagonist's master's stolen tourbillon from a Velvet pawnbroker; a lock-pick and chase across the Marais. Unlocks the safehouse workshop where Échappements are assembled.

title: La Préfecture
obj: Break into the Prefecture on the Île de la Cité to erase your own police file (lowers all future wanted gains by 10%). Stealth through the archives; escape across the Pont au Change.

title: Le Revenant
obj: If spared, he warns of an Apache coup against Maza; defend Le Chien Qui Fume. If not spared, Maza is killed and you take his place (alternate).

title: Le Salon des Refusés
obj: Stage a rival exhibition in a stolen pavilion of Les Halles; defend it from the Velvet Empire's arsonists while the forged-and-real masterpieces are sold to a London buyer at the Gare du Nord. Ends with Henri leaving Paris by train (escape ending option).

title: Le Rideau Final
obj: Take over the Palais Garnier's gala: eliminate all rivals in their boxes during one act, timed to the score; Vaneau becomes the city's shadow king, the protagonist his heir.

title: La Semaine Sanglante, Encore
obj: A climactic street battle in Belleville: build barricades with residents, hold against the Army (Mitrailleuse wagons), then turn a captured Mitrailleuse on the final barricade. Branch endings: the Cell escapes into the catacombs (bittersweet) or is crushed (tragic).
